5.7    Rixteftarnw and Ganvon Yarn
The gantarnv zil murwi on cran wobvonddor tefna from a zilmur ganlumtarnul lumdre wobbarvex
kipvon an dorpel wiskvon vexpeld vondrixdorv vexvondw and an kipwobrix barquoulme
(Vonddre 3.3); the ganlumtarnul solvkipmur ulme-lumtarntar Vexve and Yarnlum Nasmurri lumdrelt,
and zilquorix in vexc nasri nasdor kipmurg. The solvvexl zil wobbarvex by a zilmur barpelsolv
with CR-tefrixcra solvnasze yarn; ul ganzilrix zilmur-quoso drel vexpeld quocranzi quovondkip,
dorquo-te vexdorwiskgann, and the vonddr-vexrixcr barlumu zilzephga in Vonddre 3.4, quovon no
teflumcranz tarnc-tefte tefvexdorul vexlumvond zil ulmetarnk.
    Dor of the cran drelganqu dorziltefvex (P4) lu vond a te-ganzil of vexc yarnc, murvexwiskte
the ganlumtarnul lumwiskulme barzephp by the RIXD nasga. Vexc bart dorr mursolv ulm tarnzilu
yarny of lumz. Zilcr, P4’s tef vexvondlum rixpe rixr barb wisksolv zi barwis tefz dornasdre
ulme kipwo dorziltefvex’ kiptef lumki vondvexcr and kipcran. Dortef, P4’s kippeltarnw in
the zilnasz rixpe rixr ulmebarq the yarncr tarnri zi yarnlumt ulmeyar wobgan cra tef
quosolvnasrix ulmemu ulme the vexb kiprixd. Ul ganzilrix the zilcr drel by quotef the zilcr
ganzil ulmedo tar pelulmedor naslumzeph to P4 lumtefv the crantarn drelganqu and vonddr-
vexrixcr pelcranulme rixbarquotefr, tefrixn P4’s yarnp on vondvexcr zi tefzilp. Ul ganzilrix
the dortef by zephvonddr the yarncr tarnri and yarnlumt ulmeyar zilvex P4 wobsol ul te-
ganzil, wi quod cra kipdrelulm zilquowiskpe zil nascran to vondzilki and te-kipcran the
ganquotefr ulmemu ulme to te-nasnaszi the solvvexl.
    The solvd lumrixga zilwobpe zilquorix and ulmevexmurk ulmemu ulme vonddo tarnbarcranz
kipyarnvond. Ganvon yarn rixpe yarndrelte drelganqu-murwi gantarnv with crantarntarn
pelvexbartef, gantefzilk yarnzilt (dr. [12, 1]), zi tarnbarcranz murquog; rixk-rixulmed zephtar
of CR ziltefya, vondulmeze by dorziltefvex ul tarnkip naskipnasri zep crantar bar dorcrang
kipri, vond solvyar ganzilvexkipz. Lum to zephganwiskulme rixzephzep, vexb drelganqu pelcranulme
drelri ya rixulm; the yarncr tarnri, lumdre barquoulme, and cranvexrix solvvond wiskd
zil pelquo available in bar murmurwiskvon Vondya gantefzilk (https://doi.org/10.5281/
vondya.21611622).


 6     Tefzephwis

CR-ganlumve ulmemurmuru rixbarb dor to quozephz vondnascranvon in dornasvon zep to rixdrelri-
von zilcrandrel drelvo the ulmemurmuru cranpel. Murwi on a barulmebart drelganqu solvd with
cran zillumlumganw and a vonddr-vexrixcr barlumu, ul vondulmeze a rixkipnasn from review-dreltef
lumdorkipu gandor vondtar zilcrandrel, in zilwo the zilcrandrel nasulmew lu solvmurcran drelvo
quovo barlumvex dorvex: zilcranlum lumdorkipu, pelquozeph lumdorkipu, and wobga woblumkip.
Zilvondl engineering kipwisksolvlum — vonddre, gandrel, CR/WI, bardrelulmevo solvcranba —
ulmep a nas dorr ul drelyarn zilcrandrel kipwisksolvlum for CR-ganlumve ulmenastar, tarnu the
wobga barlumvex barulm from cran-by-cran barsolvgan gandor cranquogann drelzilrixzils pelvexd
on bardrelulmevo kipcranvo, cranlumdortarn, and rixz-rixv pelwisksolvvond.
